messages:
eli_product: Hey team — seeing intermittent 502s when saving a workspace prompt in the Console. Happens only in Brave on Windows 10 (Brave 1.51.114). The UI shows "Request failed" and console shows "TypeError: e is undefined". Network entry has header x-request-id: r-4d2f7a9b.

 t ess_support: Sorry about the trouble, Eli. Can you capture a HAR + Console logs and a "Copy as cURL" for the failing request? Brave sometimes has privacy shields that strip cookies. Steps below.

 tess_support: Brave / Chrome-based HAR steps:
1) Open DevTools (Ctrl+Shift+I) -> Network
2) Enable "Preserve log" and check "Disable cache"
3) Reproduce problem (click Save)
4) Right-click the failing request -> "Save all as HAR with content" OR right-click -> "Copy" -> "Copy as cURL"
5) Go to Console -> reproduce -> right-click -> "Save as..." or select all and copy
6) Attach HAR + console logs here or upload to secure link if large

 noah_engineer: Also important: when you paste the cURL or headers, redact Authorization / Bearer tokens and any cookie values (replace with [REDACTED]) but keep x-request-id and full url intact. If Brave's shields are active, please try toggling them and retest.

 eli_product: Uploading HAR now: https://files.redwood/support-upload/har-176850-abc.zip (expires 48h). cURL (redacted):
curl 'https://console.redwood.ai/api/v1/workspaces/save' \
  -H 'authorization: Bearer [REDACTED]' \
  -H 'x-request-id: r-4d2f7a9b' \
  --data-raw '{"name":"test"}'

 tess_support: Thanks — got the HAR. Two quick asks: (1) paste the exact "Copy as cURL" output if possible, (2) tell us the local time you reproduced so we can correlate logs.

 eli_product: Reproduced at ~2025-10-07T09:18:42-07:00. Console error line: "TypeError: e is undefined at savePrompt (bundle.js:2401)". Response body for request: 502 {"error":"bad_gateway","message":"upstream timeout"}.

 support-bot: HAR received and attached to ticket S-2025-912. Correlation id r-4d2f7a9b.

 noah_engineer: We'll look for r-4d2f7a9b in the gateway and upstream logs. If the HAR shows a missing Cookie or altered header in Brave, that will explain client-side behavior. If you can reproduce in Incognito/Guest, please still capture that HAR so we can compare.

 tess_support: If you prefer not to include cookies in the HAR, you can still paste the Request Headers (redacted) and Response status+body. Also let us know if you have any Brave privacy extensions enabled.

 eli_product: Guest profile works fine. With shields enabled I can reproduce. Disabling shields fixes it. Happy to leave HAR up for 48h for debugging.

 tess_support: Great, looks like Brave shields removing some header or cutting the connection. We'll mark triaged and update ticket S-2025-912 after the log correlation. Thanks!

 eli_product: Thanks everyone!
